Brief History of HHES

Historically Home Health Education Service started in January, 1994 as Tanzania Adventist Book Center (TABC) under the former Tanzania Union 
Mission of the Seventh Day Adventist Church. TABC operated for about six years which ended in May, 2000 and since then TABC was entrusted to the management of the Tanzania Adventist Press (TAP) up to December, 2007.
